user.title: BMW CarData
user.description: Enter your BMW CarData Client ID and MQTT stream topic from My BMW > CarData. Optionally enter an existing REST container ID to read battery level, charging status and charging method every two hours. Subscribe your client to cardata:api:read before enabling REST.

authorize.title: Authorize Device

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to BMW OAuth service.
error.authorization_pending: Authorization is not completed yet. Finish authorization on BMW website and retry.
error.slow_down: Polling too fast. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.access_denied: Authorization was denied on BMW website.
error.invalid_client: Client ID is invalid or not activated.
error.invalid_request: Invalid request sent to BMW OAuth service.
error.unknown_oauth_error: BMW OAuth returned an unknown error.
error.rest_scope_missing: BMW did not grant cardata:api:read. Subscribe your client to the CarData API service, then restart authorization.

abort.already_configured: This BMW account is already configured.
abort.missing_flow_state: Flow state was lost. Restart setup.
abort.wrong_account: Authorize the same BMW account as the existing integration.

init.title: BMW CarData Options
init.description: Configure MQTT and optional REST sensors. A REST container ID switches battery level, charging status and charging method to REST, with one request per vehicle every two hours. Leave it empty to use MQTT only.
